structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters

law.catch_line: Payment of annual rental; penalty for default
law.text: The applicant shall pay to the Commission annual rent of $1.50 per acre or any fraction thereof, except as provided for the Chesapeake Bay and for bathing ground. Such payment shall be due on September 1 of each year after the date of assignment, plus a ten percent penalty if not paid on or before December 5.
